title: Country Blocs & Organizations
_note: Hand-maintained registry. Memberships live in families/research/country-blocs.json.

concepts.name: EU
concepts.definition: A political and economic union of European states operating a single internal market with free movement of goods, capital, services, and people, plus common trade, agricultural, and (for eurozone members) monetary policy.

concepts.name: Eurozone
concepts.definition: A currency union of EU member states that have adopted the euro as their sole legal tender.

concepts.name: Schengen Area
concepts.definition: An area of European states that have abolished passport and immigration controls at their mutual borders to allow free movement of people.

concepts.name: EFTA
concepts.definition: A regional trade organisation coordinating a free trade area among its members while each retains its own external customs policy.

concepts.name: EEA
concepts.definition: Extends the EU single market (free movement of goods, services, capital, and people) to non-EU EFTA states.

concepts.name: Council of Europe
concepts.definition: An international organisation that works to uphold human rights, democracy, and the rule of law across Europe.

concepts.name: Nordic Council
concepts.definition: A forum for formal inter-parliamentary cooperation among the Nordic countries on legislation, culture, and regional policy.

concepts.name: V4
concepts.definition: A cultural and political alliance of four Central European states that cooperates on military, economic, cultural, and energy matters.

concepts.name: Benelux Union
concepts.definition: A political, economic, and cultural cooperation framework among Belgium, the Netherlands, and Luxembourg.

concepts.name: Baltic Assembly
concepts.definition: An interparliamentary organisation promoting cooperation between the parliaments of the three Baltic states on regional and international issues.

concepts.name: CEFTA
concepts.definition: Promotes free trade in goods and services among Western Balkan and other non-EU European states.

concepts.name: BSEC
concepts.alt_names: Organization of the Black Sea Economic Cooperation
concepts.definition: A regional organization promoting multilateral economic and political cooperation, peace, and stability among Black Sea countries.

concepts.name: NATO
concepts.definition: A collective-defense military alliance in which member states agree to mutual defense against armed attack.

concepts.name: CSTO
concepts.definition: An intergovernmental military alliance of post-Soviet states providing for mutual collective defense.

concepts.name: AUKUS
concepts.definition: A trilateral security partnership between Australia, the United Kingdom, and the United States focused on defense technology cooperation, including nuclear-powered submarines.

concepts.name: Five Eyes
concepts.definition: An intelligence alliance for joint cooperation and sharing of signals intelligence among Anglophone nations.

concepts.name: Quad
concepts.definition: An informal strategic security and diplomatic forum among four Indo-Pacific democracies to counterbalance China's regional influence.

concepts.name: OAS
concepts.definition: A hemispheric organization promoting cooperation among American states on democracy, human rights, security, and development.

concepts.name: Mercosur
concepts.definition: A South American trade bloc promoting free movement of goods, services, capital, and people among member states.

concepts.name: Pacific Alliance
concepts.definition: A Latin American trade bloc pursuing free movement of goods, services, capital, and people among member states.

concepts.name: CARICOM
concepts.definition: A regional bloc of Caribbean states that coordinates economic integration, foreign policy, and functional cooperation among its members.

concepts.name: SICA
concepts.definition: An economic and political organization promoting regional integration, peace, democracy, and development among Central American states.

concepts.name: CAN
concepts.definition: Pursues economic and social integration among Andean South American states through a free trade area and partial customs union.

concepts.name: USMCA
concepts.definition: A trilateral free trade agreement governing trade and investment among the United States, Mexico, and Canada.

concepts.name: ALBA
concepts.alt_names: Bolivarian Alliance for the Peoples of Our America
concepts.definition: An alliance of mainly Latin American and Caribbean states pursuing political, economic, and social integration through cooperation and mutual aid rather than conventional free-trade agreements.

concepts.name: CELAC
concepts.alt_names: Community of Latin American and Caribbean States
concepts.definition: A regional bloc of all Latin American and Caribbean states aimed at deepening regional integration outside US and Canadian involvement.

concepts.name: AU
concepts.definition: A continental union of African states that promotes political and economic integration, peace, and security across Africa.

concepts.name: ECOWAS
concepts.alt_names: Economic Community of West African States
concepts.definition: A regional economic union promoting economic integration and collective self-sufficiency across West Africa.

concepts.name: SADC
concepts.definition: Promotes regional socio-economic development, political cooperation, and security integration among Southern and Central African states.

concepts.name: EAC
concepts.definition: A regional intergovernmental organization promoting economic, political, and social integration among East African states.

concepts.name: COMESA
concepts.alt_names: Common Market for Eastern and Southern Africa
concepts.definition: A regional economic community of eastern and southern African states working toward a free trade area, customs union, and deeper economic integration.

concepts.name: ECCAS
concepts.alt_names: Economic Community of Central African States
concepts.definition: A regional economic community promoting economic cooperation and collective self-reliance among Central African states.

concepts.name: IGAD
concepts.definition: A regional bloc of states in the Horn of Africa that coordinates development, drought response, and security cooperation.

concepts.name: AMU
concepts.definition: A political and economic union aiming at cooperation and eventual integration among the Arab states of North Africa.

concepts.name: CEMAC
concepts.alt_names: Economic and Monetary Community of Central Africa
concepts.definition: Promotes sub-regional economic integration and monetary union among Central African states sharing the Central African CFA franc.

concepts.name: WAEMU
concepts.alt_names: West African Economic and Monetary Union
concepts.definition: A regional organization promoting monetary union and economic integration among West African states that share the CFA franc.

concepts.name: ASEAN
concepts.definition: A regional organization promoting economic growth, social progress, and political and security cooperation among Southeast Asian states.

concepts.name: SAARC
concepts.alt_names: South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation
concepts.definition: A regional intergovernmental organization promoting economic and regional integration among South Asian states.

concepts.name: SCO
concepts.definition: A Eurasian political, economic, and security organization focused on regional cooperation and counter-terrorism among its member states.

concepts.name: GCC
concepts.definition: A regional political, economic, and military union among Arab states bordering the Persian Gulf.

concepts.name: Arab League
concepts.definition: Coordinates political, economic, and cultural cooperation among Arab states and safeguards their independence and sovereignty.

concepts.name: OIC
concepts.definition: An intergovernmental organization representing the collective interests of Muslim-majority states.

concepts.name: ECO
concepts.definition: A regional intergovernmental organization promoting economic, technical, and cultural cooperation among its member states.

concepts.name: BIMSTEC
concepts.alt_names: Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation
concepts.definition: A regional organization for multi-sector technical and economic cooperation among South and Southeast Asian states bordering the Bay of Bengal.

concepts.name: OTS
concepts.definition: An intergovernmental organization of Turkic-speaking states that promotes cooperation in politics, economy, and culture.

concepts.name: CIS
concepts.definition: A regional intergovernmental organization coordinating economic, political, and military cooperation among most former Soviet republics.

concepts.name: EAEU
concepts.definition: A post-Soviet economic union providing for free movement of goods, services, capital, and labor and coordinated macroeconomic policy.

concepts.name: APEC
concepts.definition: An inter-governmental forum promoting free trade and economic cooperation among Pacific Rim economies.

concepts.name: RCEP
concepts.definition: A free trade agreement among Asia-Pacific countries that reduces tariffs and sets common rules on trade, investment, e-commerce, and intellectual property.

concepts.name: CPTPP
concepts.alt_names: Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership
concepts.definition: A multilateral free trade agreement reducing tariffs and integrating economies across the Asia-Pacific region.

concepts.name: P5
concepts.definition: The UN Security Council is the United Nations body with primary responsibility for maintaining international peace and security; its five permanent members hold veto power.

concepts.name: G7
concepts.definition: An informal forum of major advanced economies for coordinating policy on global economic, security, and climate issues.

concepts.name: G20
concepts.definition: Brings together the world's major economies to coordinate policy on global economic stability, trade, and financial regulation.

concepts.name: BRICS
concepts.definition: An intergovernmental grouping of major emerging economies that coordinates economic and diplomatic policy as a counterweight to Western-dominated institutions.

concepts.name: OPEC
concepts.alt_names: Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries
concepts.definition: An intergovernmental organization that coordinates and unifies the petroleum policies of its member countries to secure fair and stable oil prices.

concepts.name: OECD
concepts.alt_names: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development
concepts.definition: An intergovernmental forum of market-economy democracies coordinating economic policy and promoting development.

concepts.name: Commonwealth of Nations
concepts.definition: A voluntary association of mostly former British colonies and territories that cooperates on democracy, development, and shared institutions.

concepts.name: CPLP
concepts.definition: A multilateral forum deepening cultural, economic, and political cooperation among Portuguese-speaking (Lusophone) countries.

concepts.name: D-8
concepts.definition: Promotes economic cooperation and development among major Muslim-majority developing economies across finance, trade, and industry.

concepts.name: MIKTA
concepts.definition: An informal, cross-regional consultative partnership among five middle-power G20 members to deepen ties and find common ground for cooperation.

concepts.name: PIF
concepts.definition: A regional political and economic policy organization for countries and territories of Oceania.

concepts.name: MSG
concepts.definition: A sub-regional organization promoting economic growth, trade, and cultural cooperation among Melanesian states and peoples.

concepts.name: Arctic Council
concepts.definition: An intergovernmental forum of Arctic states that coordinates cooperation on environmental protection and sustainable development in the Arctic.
